goal: Let testnet nodes accept transactions with non-standard script execution behavior into the mempool
Allows developers to test soft forks and upgradable opcodes without running into standard script checks
reviewability: Ready for review with nothing known to invalidate review now
agreement: Broad concept support for making soft fork experimentation easier on testnets (benthecarman, ismaelsadeeq)
Approach approval as a pragmatic solution and logic looks correct (sedited, instagibbs)
Nonblocking objection: compile-time script flag check is harder to maintain than a unit test (fjahr)
Nonblocking objection: unnecessary and confusing type change where a unit test would suffice (sedited)

categories.name: mempool
why: P3 because it only affects test networks and provides deferrable convenience for protocol developers
Relieves friction when experimenting with new or non-standard scripts in testnet mempools
